evidence: Touches src/net_processing.cpp and alters network message handling so malformed transactions and blocks fail early at the P2P layer as deserialization errors.
rationale: Protects nodes against P2P memory and CPU exhaustion by rejecting malformed blocks and transactions before validation. As noted in the description, it prevents an attacker from sending 4 MB blocks carrying 16M weight in non-witness transactions or ~400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions that trigger individual allocations.
